inclusion: Every manifest task in the declared family; no result-dependent exclusion or selection.
fixed_cut: Exactly the archived pilot predictor with cuts 0.7 and 0.9; no tuning.

silhouette.objective: Equal mean of record-level silhouette at the upper and lower cuts of one dendrogram.
silhouette.tie_break: Objective rounded to 12 decimals, then fewer total clusters, then fewer lower clusters, then fewer upper clusters.
silhouette.duplicate_rule: Exclude candidate cuts that split any feature-identical pair with cosine distance <= 1e-12.
silhouette.zero_vectors: Zero-zero distance 0, zero-nonzero distance 1; no vocabulary or identical vectors gives a flat tree.
silhouette.no_valid_pair: One top folder with the best admissible cut from the union of candidate counts as the lower level; no admissible silhouette cut gives a flat tree.
silhouette.labels: Opaque record IDs sorted before fitting; generic output labels.

identifier_masking.scope: Thread feature-view-only diagnostic; original output record bytes remain unchanged.
identifier_masking.interpretation: Effect on this lexical procedure including its chosen shape; no agent-memorization claim.

unit_definitions.Recap_primary: AMI meeting-series prefix matching ^((?:ES|IS|TS)\d{4})[a-d]$; otherwise preserve full meeting ID and flag it.
unit_definitions.Thread: Parent issue path; descriptive only, three source parents.

source_sensitivity.rule: For each unit remove every packet containing it. Summarize remaining task means; no arbitrary single-cluster assignment.
source_sensitivity.empty_remainder: Explicit undefined value and removed-task count.
source_sensitivity.small_remainder: Retain descriptive mean with its denominator; flag fewer than five remaining packets.
source_sensitivity.inference: No confidence interval, independent-packet bootstrap or p-value.

mechanisms.partitions: ARI at first non-common folder and full leaf path; exact/refinement and split/merge counts separately.
mechanisms.privileged_repair: For a reference parent with one subgroup whose leaf set exactly matches one predicted top folder, merge its predicted leaf folders. Fixed scorer before/after; explicitly reference-assisted, never a fair baseline.
mechanisms.archived_trees: Only actual retained assignments with verified record/reference bindings; missing trees stay unavailable.

archive_eligibility: ReAct-FC only: 50 named tasks per family, verified declared public-record/reference identity, numeric per-task S, structure-score-v1 lambda 0.2, no unscored/quality filter. Disclose metadata, prompts, budgets and attempt selection. Missing evidence is explicit NA; no controlled-effects claim.
exposure: Previously exposed, overlapping existing development inputs; not confirmatory or source-disjoint.
falsifier: A strong simple baseline matching or exceeding archived agent outcomes weakens agent-specific challenge claims; preserve all such findings without retuning.
live: Blocked by the unchanged provider hold. No model preflight or source call is admitted.
